independent-implementation-review

indep-review

Shorthand: indep-review. Perform the independent Agent #2 review of an implementation artifact using the narrow three-question review contract: acceptance criteria met, no new bug/regression introduced, and implemented behavior works. Use only after a real handoff from Agent #1. Review enough surrounding code to answer those questions, route unrelated observations to the project's suggestions backlog, and do not turn review into an open-ended system audit.
